headlines.title: Italy imposes draconian rules to stop spread of coronavirus
Europe Confronts Coronavirus as Italy Battles an Eruption of Cases
headlines.abstract: The country announced more than 150 cases, many in the densely populated region around Milan, as officials closed schools and canceled Venice’s carnival celebrations.

headlines.title: Salvini attacks Italy PM over coronavirus and links to rescue ship
Coronavirus: Iran denies cover-up as six deaths reported in Italy
U.S. Stocks Plunge as Coronavirus Crisis Spreads
headlines.abstract: As outbreaks spread outside China, spiking in Italy and South Korea, investors are growing increasingly concerned about a global economic slowdown.
